posts.text: We’re pleased to reveal that Resident Evil Requiem has won several @GoldenJoysticks Awards, including: 🏆 Console Game of the Year 🏆 Best Game Trailer 🏆 Best Lead Performer: Angela Sant'Albano as Grace Ashcroft pic.twitter.com/WS4WGEoytE
posts.displayText:
We’re pleased to reveal that Resident Evil Requiem has won several @GoldenJoysticks Awards, including:

🏆 Console Game of the Year
🏆 Best Game Trailer
🏆 Best Lead Performer: Angela Sant'Albano as Grace Ashcroft pic.twitter.com/WS4WGEoytE

posts.whyItMatters: Ultimate Game of the Year is the show's top honor, and the post also lists Capcom's Studio of the Year win.
posts.author: nintendeal.com
posts.text:
Resident Evil Requiem won big at the Golden Joystick awards

- Ultimate Game of the Year
- Console Game of the Year
- Angela Sant'Albano wins Best Lead Performer for her role as Grace
- Best Game Trailer
- CAPCOM takes Studio of the Year

Very well deserved! 👏
